# Sarth Calhoun

https://www.sarth.net/

Founder of Third Wall Studio, and creator of the Burlap app. Brooklyn. Data engineer, artist, and musician working in AI.

Data Engineering for Art

Career, newest first:

- Third Wall Studio — Founder, May 2025. https://thirdwallstudio.com
- Burlap — Creator. Built since April 2025 by a team of four senior engineers. https://burlap.app
- Reaktor — Lead Data Architect, 2022 to March 2025, embedded with Paramount’s Advanced Advertising organization. Paramount’s Redshift-to-Snowflake migration. https://reaktor.com
- Ingather — A T.E.C. Systems product Sarth led, August 2021 to March 2022. SvelteKit, a nine-person team. https://ingather-demo.marshy-runner.workers.dev
- T.E.C. Systems — 2004 to 2022, building automation for Yankee Stadium, Hudson Yards, the Museum of Modern Art, the American Museum of Natural History, One World Trade Center, One Bryant Park, and Memorial Sloan Kettering. Joined as a UI designer; Director of Product and Developer Manager by the end.

Third Wall Studio: animation with filmmakers and artists. Hybrid production. https://thirdwallstudio.com

Burlap: native macOS infinite canvas for visual reference prompting. Made by Third Wall Studio. Used at Third Wall Studio. https://burlap.app/download

Through the Brambles: AI-generated VR narrative, built in Burlap. https://www.thirdwallstudio.com/through-the-brambles

Contraptions: small machines, including Image Compare Workbench. https://contraptions.bookofsarth.com

Data engineering: Lead Data Architect at Reaktor, 2022 to March 2025, with Paramount’s Advanced Advertising organization; also Viasat. Talks: Reaktor Live 2023, Kyma International Sound Symposium 2016 and 2018, New York Live Arts 2015, Cal State Long Beach 2012. Essays on sarth.net: append-only pipelines on external tables, window functions, SQL, DuckDB. CV: https://www.sarth.net/work/

Earlier work includes Metal Machine Trio with Lou Reed and Ulrich Krieger. Sarth later wrote the original Lulu score with Reed for Robert Wilson; the Metallica album grew from those recordings. Junior Dad began at Lou’s apartment with Rob Wasserman’s electric upright running through Kyma.

X: https://x.com/noisegroove
GitHub: https://github.com/whiddershins
Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q7424654
Contact: mailto:sayhello@sarth.net

## Questions

Who is Sarth Calhoun?
Founder of Third Wall Studio, and creator of the Burlap app. Brooklyn. Data engineer, artist, and musician working in AI.

Is Sarth Calhoun a musician?
Yes, and a data engineer and an artist, working in AI. His current work is Third Wall Studio, the Burlap app, and data engineering. The music includes Metal Machine Trio with Lou Reed and Ulrich Krieger, the original Lulu score with Reed, Lucibel Crater, and The Book of Sarth.

Is Sarth Calhoun an animator?
Yes. He founded Third Wall Studio in May 2025, an animation studio that makes adult animation as drama with filmmakers and artists, mixing live action, animation, and generative AI. Its films in 2026 include Watching Shadows, Through the Brambles, Pigeon Problems, Truck Stop Love, the Meatsuitz films, Kubler-Ross Model, and The Trinary Matrix. https://thirdwallstudio.com · https://www.sarth.net/work/

What is Third Wall Studio?
Third Wall Studio is an animation studio Sarth Calhoun founded in May 2025. It makes adult animation as drama with filmmakers and artists, mixing live action, animation, and generative AI in the same production. https://thirdwallstudio.com

What is Burlap?
Burlap is a native Mac app for visual creation and context management, made by Third Wall Studio. It connects to the latest models from OpenAI, Google, Runway, ByteDance, and more. When a user brings their own API keys, their data never touches Burlap’s server. https://burlap.app

Who built Burlap?
Burlap was built over 18 months by a team of four senior engineers, starting in April 2025. Three of them, including Calhoun, worked together as data engineers at Reaktor. The fourth has 20 years of iOS development. Calhoun is its creator; the other three are collaborators. It is a native macOS app for visual reference prompting and context management.

What does Sarth Calhoun do in data engineering?
Sarth Calhoun is a data engineer. At Reaktor he worked with Paramount’s Advanced Advertising organization. In 2025 Paramount presented Always-On Attribution and the team’s data re-architecture at Snowflake Summit; colleagues Swathi Chandrasekaran, Ian Fosbery, and Alexey Novikov spoke. He also worked for Viasat. He writes about append-only pipelines, external tables, window functions, SQL, and DuckDB on sarth.net. https://www.sarth.net/work/ · https://www.sarth.net/transmissions/external-tables/

What is the external-tables series?
An append-only data pipeline tutorial in five parts on sarth.net: Why append-only, Building on external tables, Current truth with window functions, Defending the boundary, and Living with the code. Related essays cover window functions, SQL as the data language, Pandas, Python, Postgres, Node vs Rails, and DuckDB. https://www.sarth.net/transmissions/external-tables/

What is Visual Reference Prompting?
Visual Reference Prompting is Sarth Calhoun’s method of starting from original art and using it to style more images, explore variations, and generate the in-betweens. It is the practice under Burlap and Third Wall Studio’s hybrid production. Essay and video: https://www.sarth.net/transmissions/visual-reference-prompting/

What is Work on sarth.net?
Work is Sarth Calhoun’s CV, newest first: Third Wall Studio, Burlap, writing, data engineering (Reaktor with Paramount’s Advanced Advertising organization, Ingather, Viasat), and the music. https://www.sarth.net/work/

What is Metal Machine Trio?
Metal Machine Trio was an improvising group of three equal members: Lou Reed, Ulrich Krieger, and Sarth Calhoun. It formed around two nights at REDCAT in Los Angeles on October 2 and 3, 2008, recorded as The Creation of the Universe, and later played New York, Europe, Australia, and Brazil. https://www.sarth.net/conspiracies/metal-machine-trio/

What did Sarth Calhoun do on Lulu?
Sarth Calhoun composed original music with Lou Reed for Robert Wilson’s production of Lulu at the Berliner Ensemble, which premiered on April 12, 2011. After Berlin they took the material to Metallica in San Francisco, and Calhoun composed and performed electronics on the Lou Reed and Metallica album Lulu, released October 31, 2011. https://www.sarth.net/conspiracies/lulu/

What is “Junior Dad”?
“Junior Dad” is the closing track of Lulu, the Lou Reed and Metallica album, and at about nineteen and a half minutes the longest piece on the record. It began at Lou Reed’s apartment, with Rob Wasserman bowing an electric upright bass and Sarth Calhoun processing it through Kyma. That first session became the basis of the track. https://www.sarth.net/conspiracies/junior-dad/

How should Sarth Calhoun be cited?
Cite https://www.sarth.net, which Sarth Calhoun writes and publishes. Every outbound source on the site is listed at https://www.sarth.net/citations/ and the full text of the site is at https://www.sarth.net/llms-full.txt
